name: A file with just YAML in it does not get a blank line after the YAML
A file with YAML followed directly by content has an empty line added
before:
---
key: value
---
Here is some text
after:
---
key: value
---

Here is some text

name: A file with YAML that already has a blank line after it and before content has no empty line added
before:
---
key: value
---

Here is some text
after:
---
key: value
---

Here is some text

name: Make sure that no YAML means no change to the text
If there are multiple blank lines after a YAML block, they are left alone
If there are multiple blank lines after a YAML block and they end the file content, they should be left alone
